request_text: Our AI can't resolve roaming disputes after a mid-cycle plan change. Customers escalate and we have no one to route to.
Our support bot handles refunds fine until the order was split across two shipments or partially returned. Those get stuck and we need a human who knows the edge cases.

We build evaluation sets for customer-support AI. We need the specific situations where a support model confidently gives the wrong answer — thresholds, exceptions, timing rules a script never states.
